descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S04 Existing spec: Settings offers no dictation engine choice

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 No API key fields, model pickers or dictation engine choice appear anywhere in the app, in Hospital and Nursing Home. This is the OAT-05 part of the AC; bulk delete and demo data are TC-24 scope. (TFA-94700 AC 5)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium fixtures (signed-in account)

When Open /settings and wait for the Settings heading

Then Once the Settings heading is visible, there is no On-device or Cloud engine choice and no 'Choose whether dictation runs' text.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in forms.spec.ts, after the heading wait. This covers the engine-choice part of TFA-94700 AC 5 in Hospital mode. The sibling test 'does not expose model or AI connection controls' is not counted: it asserts toHaveCount(0) right after page.goto('/settings') with no wait for the Settings heading, so it can pass before the modal renders, and it checks only t …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).
